description: Goal: no string math, concatenation or copying unless the result needs new bytes; minimal garbage. Runtime: views carry their length (S1), <> appends in place (S2, still open as fz-nml.29), ::utf8 matches (S3). Library: JSON numbers from their text (S4), one-pass decode (S5), one-pass encode into one buffer (S6), integer boxing at <<c>> (F). Garbage pins count allocs - continuation_allocs. Proposal page: /Users/j5n/Workspace/fz-json-garbage.html (approved 2026-11-14). Worktree ../fz-json, base bd3edae98.
title: Binaries make no garbage they do not need
